title: So thin you can see thru them
text: So thin you can see thru them. These are as thin as a paper towel. These will do nothing to protect the tabletop, only for decoration. The print is pretty and bright, but you can see the table thru the placemats and runner. I expected a bit heavier fabric. Not sure if I am going to keep them or not...can't imagine what they are going to look like after laundering them. So disappointing.
